purpose: Create the canonical immutable rootless TAI Agro OS runtime image and exact-SHA publication authority without changing the live REG.RU service topology or expanding TAI write authority.
requiredBehavior: build a canonical TAI runtime image from exact repository source
publish only exact-SHA tagged TAI images through the existing GHCR authority
run the service as unprivileged uid and gid 65532
package the complete governed TAI migration manifest and SQL history
bake no secrets database URLs model keys tenant data or production configuration into the image
keep liveness independent from dependency readiness
fail readiness closed when production configuration is absent
bind the runtime Dockerfile into the TAI release source digest
recognize only the governed TAI image as canonical while preserving the retirement of apps ml and Airflow
separate image publication evidence from REG.RU deployment evidence
forbiddenCapabilities: new paid service or recurring expense
reactivation of apps ml or Airflow
